skill.name: doc-sync
skill.description: Helps keep IdeaVim documentation aligned with code changes by verifying documentation, examples, API signatures, and git history before applying targeted updates.
skill.summary: Verifies IdeaVim documentation against current code and guides targeted documentation updates.
skill.author: JetBrains

security_audit.summary: Static analysis flagged Markdown backticks, fenced shell examples, and an IdeaVim mapping search pattern. Review found no prompt injection, malware intent, credential access, network access, or data exfiltration behavior in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - **Check git history:** Run `git log -10` on changed files, look for "remove" commits
- **Understand deletions:** Run `git show [commit]` to see what was removed

content.value_statement: IdeaVim code changes can leave documentation examples outdated. This skill helps compare docs with current APIs, git history, and working implementations.
actual_capabilities: Guides searches for real Kotlin implementations before editing documentation.
Checks recent git history for removed, deprecated, or changed APIs.
Compares documented signatures and parameters against current source code.
Finds documentation files that reference changed features or classes.
Produces a clear report of checked files, discrepancies, and updates.
limitations: It is tailored to the IdeaVim project layout and documentation style.
It needs local repository access and working grep, find, and git commands.
It cannot guarantee accuracy without reading the relevant implementation files.
Ambiguous behavior changes may still need maintainer review.

use_cases.title: Review documentation after API changes
use_cases.description: Check affected IdeaVim docs after a Kotlin API, class, or parameter changes.

use_cases.title: Validate examples before release
use_cases.description: Compare documentation examples with working implementations before publishing a release.

use_cases.title: Audit broad documentation drift
use_cases.description: Scan documentation for outdated mappings, signatures, and file references.

prompt_templates.title: Check one document
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a single documentation file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether doc/ideavim-mappings.md matches the current IdeaVim code. Report any outdated examples and update only confirmed issues.

prompt_templates.title: Review a changed file
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review after editing source code.
prompt_templates.prompt: I changed MappingScope.kt. Find related documentation, compare examples with current implementations, and update docs only where behavior or API usage changed.

prompt_templates.title: Verify deleted API references
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review focused on removals and breaking changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use recent git history to identify removed or deprecated mapping APIs. Then check documentation for stale references and prepare precise updates.

prompt_templates.title: Audit all documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Check all IdeaVim documentation for outdated signatures, parameter names, and mapping examples. Prioritize issues that would break user code.

output_examples.input: Check one mapping document against current source code.
output: Files checked include the mapping document and related Kotlin implementation files.
One outdated parameter name was found in a documented example.
The documentation was updated to match the current API, with no style-only edits.

output_examples.input: Review docs after a source file changed.
output: Recent git history showed a removed mapping option.
Two documentation references were still using the old option name.
Both references were updated, and one ambiguous behavior note was left for maintainer review.

output_examples.input: Run a broad documentation drift audit.
output: The audit checked documentation files for signatures, mapping examples, and file references.
No broken examples were confirmed in the reviewed files.
The report lists the implementation files used as ground truth.

best_practices: Start with current working code before trusting existing documentation.
Check deletions and renamed parameters before editing examples.
Make narrow documentation changes that preserve the existing style.
anti_patterns: Do not update wording just because it could sound better.
Do not rely on documentation as the source of truth.
Do not remove helpful context unless the current code proves it wrong.

faq.question: What project is this skill designed for?
faq.answer: It is designed for the IdeaVim repository and its documentation structure.

faq.question: Can it update documentation files?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides targeted edits when code review confirms that documentation is outdated.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It suggests local grep, find, and git commands for repository analysis. The user or agent environment controls execution.

faq.question: What should be used as ground truth?
faq.answer: Current working implementation files and API definitions should be treated as the highest authority.

faq.question: Can it check every documentation file?
faq.answer: Yes, but broad audits take more time and still require source files for comparison.

faq.question: Will it make style-only documentation changes?
faq.answer: No. The workflow recommends edits only for confirmed accuracy problems.
